RUNNER_TOKEN.description: Registration token from GitHub's new self-hosted runner flow. Create it for the organization or repository you choose below.

RUNNER_SCOPE.description: Choose whether this runner belongs to an organization or a single repository.

LABELS.description: Comma-separated labels for this runner. Reference these in workflow YAML with runs-on to target this runner.

RUNNER_NAME_PREFIX.description: Prefix for the generated runner name. Lawn adds a unique suffix so multiple runners can coexist.

START_DOCKER_SERVICE.description: Start Docker inside the runner so workflows can use Docker-based actions, docker run, and docker compose. Disable this only if you do not run container-based workflow steps.

REPO_URL.description: Full GitHub repository URL, such as https://github.com/your-org/your-repo. Required only for repository runners.

ORG_NAME.description: GitHub organization name, such as your-org. Required only for organization runners.

RUNNER_SCOPE.description: Scope of the runner: repo (single repository), org (entire organization), or ent (GitHub Enterprise). Defaults to repo.

LABELS.description: Comma-separated labels for this runner. Reference these in workflow YAML with runs-on to target this specific runner.

RUNNER_NAME_PREFIX.description: Prefix for the auto-generated runner name. A random suffix is appended to ensure uniqueness across multiple instances.

START_DOCKER_SERVICE.description: Starts Docker inside the runner so workflows can use Docker-based actions, docker run, and docker compose.

CONFIGURED_ACTIONS_RUNNER_FILES_DIR.description: Directory where runner registration state is persisted across restarts.

RUNNER_WORKDIR.description: Working directory for workflow job execution inside the container.

DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE.description: Prevents the runner binary from self-updating, keeping the pinned image version in use.

DISABLE_AUTOMATIC_DEREGISTRATION.description: Keeps the registered runner attached to GitHub when Lawn stops or restarts it.

UNSET_CONFIG_VARS.description: Clears GitHub credential environment variables after runner registration to prevent them from leaking into workflow steps.

token-instructions.content: Before starting, choose whether this runner belongs to an organization or a repository, then provide the matching runner token plus the organization name or repository URL.

setup-guide.content: In GitHub, open the organization or repository runner settings, choose **New self-hosted runner**, and copy the token from the setup command. The runner registration is stored by Lawn and reused across restarts.
